name: Volume Rendering based CGH Calculation
aliases: Direct volume rendering method for holograms
Approximate Volume Rendering Based CGH Calculation
Approximate Volume Rendering Based CGH Calculation with Elemental Holograms
Approximate volume rendering based CGH calculation method with elemental holograms
definition: A method to generate Computer-Generated Holograms (CGHs) for volume data by treating voxels as transparent objects with diffuse reflection, allowing for the generation of holograms for transparent and multi-layer objects.
summary: Volume Rendering based CGH Calculation generates holograms by simulating light propagation and diffuse reflection from voxels, offering superior detail for transparent objects compared to Maximum Intensity Projection.
